CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.KOL_EksportDyspLista(@DataOd int, @DataDo int, @Kontrahent int, @Magazyn int, @OpeNumer int, @trntyp varchar(200), @zamtyp varchar(200),@mantyp varchar(200)) AS BEGIN -- Magazynowe SELECT DISTINCT CDN.NumerDokumentu(maN_GIDTyp,0,man_trnTyp,man_trnNumer,maN_trNRok,maN_trNSeria,MaN_TrNMiesiac) as [Nr Dokumentu], CASE WHEN MaN_ZrdTyp = 960 THEN CDN.NumerDokumentu(CDN.DokMapTypDokumentu(ZaN_GIDTyp,ZaN_ZamTyp,ZaN_Rodzaj),0,0,ZaN_ZamNumer,ZaN_ZamRok,ZaN_ZamSeria,ZaN_ZamMiesiac) WHEN MaN_ZrdTyp in (2002,2000,1603,1604,1521,1529,1489,1497,1490,1498,2033,2041,2036,2044,2001,2009,2034,2042,2035,2043,2037,2045,2005,2013,1312,1824,1616,1617) THEN CDN.NumerDokumentu(TrN_GIDTyp,TrN_SpiTyp,TrN_TrNTyp,TrN_TrNNumer,TrN_TrNRok,TrN_TrNSeria,TrN_TrNMiesiac) ELSE '<BRAK>' END As [Dokument zrd.], CDN.TsToDate(MaN_Data3,0) As [Data Dok], isnull(Knt_Akronim,'<BRAK>') As [Kontrahent], Mag_Kod As [KOD MAGAZYNU], MaN_GidTyp As GidTyp, MaN_GidNumer As GidNumer, isnull(Man_KntNumer,0) As KntNumer, isnull(KDO_OpeNumer,0) As [Edytowal], MaN_ZrdTyp As ZrdTyp FROM CDN.MagNag JOIN CDN.Str2List(@mantyp) ON MaN_GIDTyp=Num JOIN CDN.Magazyny ON MAG_GIDNumer=MaN_TrMNumer AND MAG_GIDTyp=MaN_TrMTyp AND ((MAG_GIDNumer = @Magazyn) OR (@Magazyn = -1)) LEFT JOIN CDN.KntKarty on Man_KntNumer=Knt_GidNumer AND Man_KntTyp=Knt_GidTyp LEFT JOIN CDN.Tranag ON TrN_GIDNumer=MaN_ZrdNumer and TrN_GIDTyp=MaN_ZrdTyp LEFT JOIN CDN.ZamNag ON ZaN_GIDNumer=MaN_ZrdNumer and ZaN_GIDTyp=MaN_ZrdTyp LEFT JOIN CDN.KolDokumenty ON MaN_GidNumer=KDo_DokNumer AND MaN_GidTyp=KDO_DokTyp AND KDO_OpeNumer=@OpeNumer LEFT JOIN CDN.MagsElem on Man_GidNumer=MaS_GIDNumer LEFT JOIN CDN.MagElem on MaN_GIDNumer=MaE_GIDNumer WHERE Man_Data3 BETWEEN @DataOd AND @DataDo AND MaN_Stan < 5 and MaN_Aktywny = 0 AND ((man_kntNumer = @Kontrahent) OR (@Kontrahent = -1)) GROUP BY MaN_GIDTyp,man_trnTyp,man_trnNumer,maN_trNRok,maN_trNSeria,MaN_TrNMiesiac, MaN_ZrdTyp, ZaN_GIDTyp, ZaN_ZamTyp, ZaN_Rodzaj, ZaN_ZamNumer , ZaN_ZamRok, ZaN_ZamSeria, ZaN_ZamMiesiac, TrN_GIDTyp,TrN_SpiTyp,TrN_TrNTyp,TrN_TrNNumer,TrN_TrNRok,TrN_TrNSeria,TrN_TrNMiesiac, MaN_Data3,Knt_Akronim,Mag_Kod,MaN_GidTyp,MaN_GidNumer,Man_KntNumer,KDO_OpeNumer having (count(MaS_GIDNumer) > 0 or MaN_GidTyp = 1602) and (count(MaE_GIDNumer) >0 or MaN_GidTyp in (1089,1601))
UNION ALL -- Zamówienia SELECT DISTINCT CDN.NumerDokumentu(CDN.DokMapTypDokumentu(ZaN_GIDTyp, ZaN_ZamTyp, ZaN_Rodzaj),0,0, ZaN_ZamNumer , ZaN_ZamRok, ZaN_ZamSeria, ZaN_ZamMiesiac) As [Nr Dokumentu], '<BRAK>' As [Dokument zrd.], CDN.TsToDate(ZaN_DataPotwierdz,0) As [Data Dok], isnull(Knt_Akronim,'<BRAK>') As [Kontrahent], Mag_Kod as [KOD MAGAZYNU], CDN.DokMapTypDokumentu (ZaN_GIDTyp,ZaN_ZamTyp,ZaN_Rodzaj) As GidTyp, Zan_Gidnumer As GidNumer, isnull(Zan_KntNumer,0) As KntNumer, 0 As [Edytowal], 0 As ZrdTyp FROM CDN.ZamNag JOIN CDN.Str2List(@zamtyp) ON CDN.DokMapTypDokumentu(ZaN_GIDTyp,ZaN_ZamTyp,ZaN_Rodzaj)=Num JOIN CDN.Magazyny on Mag_GidNumer = ZaN_MagNumer AND Mag_GidTyp = ZaN_MagTyp AND ((Mag_gidNumer = @Magazyn) OR (@Magazyn = -1)) LEFT JOIN CDN.KntKarty on Zan_KntNumer = Knt_GidNumer AND Zan_KntTyp = Knt_GidTyp WHERE ZaN_DataPotwierdz BETWEEN @DataOd AND @DataDo AND ZaN_Aktywny = 0 AND ((Zan_KntNumer = @Kontrahent) OR (@Kontrahent = -1)) AND (ZAN_Stan=3 or (zan_stan=5 and exists(select * from cdn.zamelem join cdn.twrkarty on twr_gidnumer=zae_twrnumer left join ( select sum(mas_ilosc) as mas_ilosc,mas_twrnumer,mas_zlclp from cdn.magnag join cdn.magselem on MaN_GIDTyp=MaS_GIDTyp AND MaN_GIDNumer=MaS_GIDNumer where man_zrdnumer=zan_gidnumer and man_zrdtyp=960 group by mas_twrnumer,mas_zlclp ) m on mas_twrnumer=zae_twrnumer and mas_zlclp=zae_gidlp where zae_gidnumer=zan_gidnumer and zae_magnumer=@Magazyn and zae_ilosc-isnull(mas_ilosc,0)>0) ) ) AND EXISTS(select * from CDN.ZamElem join CDN.TwrKarty on Twr_GIDNumer=ZaE_TwrNumer where ZaE_GIDNumer=ZaN_GIDNumer and Twr_Typ not in (3,4,6) and (ZaE_MagNumer=@Magazyn or isnull(ZaE_MagNumer,0)=0))
UNION ALL -- Handlowe SELECT DISTINCT CDN.NumerDokumentu(TrN_GIDTyp,TrN_SpiTyp,TrN_TrNTyp,TrN_TrNNumer,TrN_TrNRok,TrN_TrNSeria,TrN_TrNMiesiac) As [Nr Dokumentu], '<BRAK>' As [Dokument zrd.], CDN.TsToDate(TrN_Data2,0) As [Data Dok], ISNULL(Knt_Akronim,'<BRAK>') As [Kontrahent], Mag_Kod AS [KOD MAGAZYNU], TrN_GIDTyp As GidTyp, TrN_GIDNumer As GidNumer, ISNULL(TrN_KntNumer,0) As KntNumer, 0 As [Edytowal], 0 As ZrdTyp FROM CDN.TraNag JOIN CDN.Str2List(@trntyp) ON TrN_GIDTyp=Num LEFT JOIN CDN.KntKarty ON TrN_KntNumer=Knt_GIDNumer AND TrN_KntTyp=32 JOIN CDN.Magazyny ON Mag_GIDNumer = CASE WHEN TrN_GidTyp in (2033, 2001, 2034, 1616, 1603, 2037, 2005, 2000) THEN TrN_MagZNumer else TrN_MagDNumer END WHERE TrN_Data2 BETWEEN @DataOd AND @DataDo AND TrN_Stan between 3 AND 5 AND TrN_Aktywny = 0 AND ((TrN_KntNumer = @Kontrahent) OR (@Kontrahent = -1)) AND ((TrN_MagDNumer = @Magazyn) OR (TrN_MagZNumer = @Magazyn) OR (@Magazyn = -1)) AND TrN_GenDokMag in (0,1) --AND ((select isnull(sum(tre_ilosc),0) from cdn.traelem where tre_gidnumer=TrN_GIDNumer)>(select isnull(sum(mae_ilosc),0) from cdn.magnag join cdn.magelem on man_gidnumer=mae_gidnumer where man_zrdnumer=TrN_GIDNumer and man_zrdtyp=trn_gidtyp)) --AND EXISTS(select * from CDN.TraElem WHERE TrE_GIDNumer=TrN_GIDNumer AND TrE_TypTwr NOT IN (3,4,6)) AND EXISTS(select * from CDN.TraSElem WHERE TrS_GIDNumer=TrN_GIDNumer AND (@Magazyn=-1 OR TrS_MagNumer=@Magazyn OR isnull(TrS_MagNumer,0)=0)) END
